title: Three-Body Problem as Chinese soft disclosure
summary: David Grusch tells of Three-Body Problem as Chinese soft disclosure, about an unknown time at China, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: but they've allowed this sci fi series to be published by this Chinese author, that's like pretty trippy.

plain: David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who has said the government holds non-human craft, told podcast host Jesse Michels he finds it "pretty trippy" that China allowed The Three-Body Problem, a science fiction series by a Chinese author about contact with aliens, to be published. He hints it could be a form of soft disclosure, a government quietly preparing the public through fiction. If so, China would be signalling what it knows.
